stem.text: The Boltzmann distribution for one mole of a gas at temperature $T$ is shown.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution curve: number of particles with energy E against energy E, starting at zero, rising to a peak at low energy and falling away gradually

stem.text: One mole of the same gas is added, and the gas remains at temperature $T$.
Which dotted curve shows the distribution with the added gas?

A.alt: Solid Boltzmann curve with a dotted curve lying above it at all energies, with a higher peak at a similar energy

B.alt: Solid Boltzmann curve with a dotted curve peaking at higher energy and lower height than the solid peak

C.alt: Solid Boltzmann curve with a dotted curve having a sharp, tall peak at low energy

D.alt: Solid Boltzmann curve with a dotted curve peaking at higher energy and at about the same height as the solid peak
